derivation.note: Basis points of easing the 1-year Treasury prices versus the current target midpoint. Positive = cuts priced. A curve-based stand-in for CME FedWatch.

move.detail: -3 bp. Bigger in magnitude than 65% of the 2203 moves since 2018-01-03. The typical move is 3.1 bp; this is 0.5 sigma.

insights.stat_line: Sitting in the bottom of its 1-year range, at the 7th percentile.

impact.meaning: A RISE in this series pushes mortgage rates DOWN. A fall pushes them UP.
impact.no_chain_note: This series is not a node in the causal graph. It is context, not a modeled driver of mortgage rates.
